title: Pure Red-Eyes
summary: Pure Red-Eyes beatdown and burn strategy combining Joey Wheeler's signature Dragon with modern support and Max Metalmorph. The deck accelerates Level 7 Dragons and Gemini or Normal Dragons into heavy burn damage, Link climbs, and disruptive Fusion or Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: The Black Stone of Legend tributes itself to Special Summon any Level 7 or lower Red-Eyes monster directly from the Deck, and recycles a Level 7 or lower Red-Eyes from the GY to add itself back to hand.
Black Metal Dragon equips from the hand or field to a Red-Eyes monster to boost it by 600 ATK, and searches any Red-Eyes card from the Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Red-Eyes Insight sends a Red-Eyes monster from the hand or Deck to the GY to search any Red-Eyes Spell or Trap card.
Red-Eyes Black Meteor Dragon sends a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from hand or Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself, and banishes itself from the GY to search Red-Eyes Fusion.

summary.title: Opening: Black Metal Dragon
steps: Normal Summon Black Metal Dragon and send it to the GY to Link Summon Striker Dragon.
Trigger Black Metal Dragon's GY effect to add Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon from your Deck to your hand.
Banish Striker Dragon to Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon from your hand.
Activate Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon's effect to revive Black Metal Dragon from your GY.
Equip Black Metal Dragon or use both dragons for further Link or Fusion extension, chaining Black Metal Dragon's search when it leaves the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Red-Eyes Flare Metal Dragon cannot be destroyed by card effects while it has Xyz Material, inflicts 500 damage to the opponent every time they activate a card or effect, and detaches a material as a Quick Effect to revive a Red-Eyes Normal Monster.
Meteor Black Comet Dragon inflicts damage equal to half the original ATK of a Red-Eyes monster sent from the hand or Deck on Fusion Summon, and revives a Normal Monster from the GY when destroyed.
Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon is summoned via Max Metalmorph, negates an opponent's card or effect while burning them for its original ATK, and cannot be destroyed by battle or Spells.
Red-Eyes Slash Dragon negates an effect that targets a card you control by sending an equipped card to the GY, and equips fallen Warriors to itself whenever a Red-Eyes monster attacks.
Red-Eyes Soul counts as Red-Eyes Black Dragon on field or in GY, summons a Red-Eyes from Deck when the opponent Special Summons, and burns for that monster's original ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Red-Eyes Fusion uses materials from the hand, Deck, or field to Fusion Summon a Red-Eyes Fusion Monster, locking you out of other Normal or Special Summons for the turn.
Max Metalmorph tributes a Level 5 or higher Dragon to Special Summon Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon directly from the Deck, ignoring its summoning conditions.
Return of the Red-Eyes repeatedly revives Normal Monsters from the GY each turn while you control a Red-Eyes monster.
Cards of the Red Stone discards a Level 7 Red-Eyes monster to draw 2 cards, then optionally mills another Level 7 Red-Eyes from the Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon requires Dark Magician, and Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed requires a Dark Time Wizard monster, so both are left out of this pure Dragon and Metalmorph variant.

allow.Max Metalmorph: Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon and Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon both name it: it summons Fullmetal from the Deck.
allow.Striker Dragon: Link-1 Dragon that sends Normal Summoned Dragons (like Black Metal Dragon) to GY to trigger their search effects.

Red-Eyes Black Meteor Dragon
Mills a Level 5+ Normal Monster to summon itself; from the GY, adds Red-Eyes Fusion.

Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon

Tributes a Red-Eyes to summon itself; destroyed, revives one.

Red-Eyes Insight
Mills a Red-Eyes to search a Red-Eyes Spell/Trap.
